title: PLAYER 1 AND PLAYER 2 SEE EACH OTHER IN THE UNDERCROFT
why: His order of 2026-10-18 after his first look at the two-window game: players 1 and 2 should be able to see each other in the undercroft. The floor drew the other player only over the WebRTC link, which comes up some seconds after the pick, and never before it. The pair channel the two windows already talk on is up at once, so each window now posts where it stands on the floor a few times a second (with the pair code, its name and its look) and says once when it leaves the floor, and the other window draws that body with the same operator drawing the party uses, with its name over its head. A silent body goes by itself, a linked party that already shows him is not drawn twice, and solo play posts and draws nothing.
now: The other player now appears in the Undercroft as soon as both windows are on the floor, walking and standing where they are, with a name over the head, and disappears when that window leaves the floor.
